Clockwork_Propeller_Fins.description: These intricate, clockwork-driven fins are a marvel of mechanical engineering, allowing the construct to glide through water with unparalleled speed and agility, their gears and cogs whirring in perfect synchronization with each stroke.

Heavy_Iron_Rudder_Fins.description: These heavy iron rudder fins, forged from the darkest steel and enchanted to mimic the natural movement of living fins, grant their bearer a powerful swimming ability at the cost of stealth, enhancing their resilience in aquatic combat and allowing them to block and resist knockback with formidable strength.

Steam_Venting_Jet_Fins.description: These mechanical jet fins, venting scalding steam with each powerful thrust, propel the construct through aquatic realms with unmatched velocity, though the oppressive heat they emit can be off-putting to observers, reducing their charisma.

Crystal_Acoustic_Sonar_Fins.description: Emerging from the depths of a dark, crystal-infused sea, these sleek, bioluminescent fins are both a marvel and a terror. Crafted from a rare, magical alloy that resonates with the whispers of the deep, they grant their bearer an unparalleled echolocation ability, allowing them to navigate the darkest waters with grace and precision, while also emitting a soft, mesmerizing light that can blind or confuse foes.

Necrotic_Stitched_Webbed_Fins.description: These grotesque, webbed appendages are crafted from the desiccated flesh of fallen warriors, stitched together in a macabre dance of necromancy and dark engineering, granting the wielder a chilling presence and the ability to glide through water with unnatural speed, though at a horrifying cost to their charisma.

Living_Wood_Kelp_Like_Fins.description: The Living Wood Kelp Like Fins are surreal, plant-like appendages that undulate gracefully through water, their wooden texture intertwined with strands of seaweed, granting both enhanced constitution and a subtle stealth bonus, allowing their wielder to blend seamlessly into the marine environment and regenerate wounds with the nurturing essence of living wood.

Scrap_Metal_Paddle_Fins.description: Rusted scrap metal twisted into the shape of powerful fins, these mechanical appendages allow for swift and forceful underwater movement, augmenting both strength and speed while granting the user the ability to sunder foes and dash through aquatic environments with unparalleled ferocity.

Mithril_Bladed_Hydrofoil_Fins.description: These sleek, mithril-bladed hydrofoil fins are a marvel of dark elven craftsmanship, seamlessly integrating cold, metallic grace with the fluid motion of aquatic predators, granting unparalleled speed and agility to any creature that wields them.

Porcelain_Doll_Frilled_Fins.description: The Porcelain_Doll_Frilled_Fins are delicate yet fearsome appendages, crafted from a brittle yet resilient ceramic material that mimics the soft, doll-like texture of human skin, allowing the construct to glide silently through water with mesmerizing grace while its haunting beauty lures prey to their doom.

Arcane_Energy_Thruster_Fins.description: Emerging from the sleek, serpentine body of the construct, the Arcane Energy Thruster Fins pulse with a vibrant, otherworldly glow, enhancing the creature's agility in water and granting it a profound understanding of arcane energies, allowing it to resist magical interference and propel itself at incredible speeds.
